scope: Read primary papers and official source;no new merger implementation or claimed reproduction.

TSV.findings: Tasklayer SVD and orthogonalization are established. Main evaluation constructs vectors separately from val/test evaluation. Officialcode chooses a coefficient on validation before test and reports absolute/normalizedaccuracy;default8tasks/31points differs from our fixedTA.5 pair.

PaRaMS.findings: Report standalonebefore/after and merging both target/partner;deleting individual modules isolates contribution;coefficient/taskcount sensitivity and cost are separate. Different coefficients or taskaverages must not be mixed with our fixedpair.

AGA.findings: Separate protected-task accuracy from cross-task average. Defenseagnostic core applies to all candidateexperts;our targetonly/both explicitly separated. Standalonepostattack and parameter sensitivity are distinct evaluations,not additional attackalgorithms.

our_priority: Numericalposthoc mechanism and non-invertible fused function,without actualconstructionimages;not importing more fusion algorithms. SVD contribution must follow our ablation evidence.

EMMET_MEMIT.source_findings: Officialcode recomputes currentlayerkeys and finalresidual;distributes residual over remaininglayers. EMMETusescovinverseandkeyGramregularization,MEMITuseslinear solveofcovpluskeyGram. Preservationcovariance is computedfrom mom2_dataset activations. This is not a datafreepipeline to copy into our frozenCLIP experiment.
EMMET_MEMIT.contribution_boundary: Equalityconstraints,regularizedassociativememory and residualdistribution are existingtechniques. Papercomparison distinguishes optimizationobjective from layerdistribution;cannotclaimourpinv/ridge asnewmethod.

AlphaEdit_LEACE.source_byte_pinning: BothdirectAPIrequests404;web maincode read,but no newfixedcommit/bytearchive. PreviousfixedMEMIT/EMMET23d72b56stillavailable. Neither imported nor executed.
AlphaEdit_LEACE.findings: Preservedkey nullspace projection and minimum-norm editing are established. LEACE uses centered feature/concept covariances with whitening;its convex-loss linear-guardedness result is not a fixed-head score-neutrality guarantee. AlphaEditcode uses key/cacheprojected solve and residualdivision acrosslayers,with corpus covariance in get_cov. These statistics are not copied as datafree.
AlphaEdit_LEACE.ours: ExactLayerNorm-affine neutralhead constraints plus one finite native/task-probe-preserving parameter solve;no claimthatstandardpseudo-inverse/nullspace isoriginal,thatallhiddenfeatureinformationiserased,or unknownpartnersguaranteed.

Pre_LN_structure.scope: Pre-LN residual architecture only, not transfer of the paper initialization theorem to frozen-task security. Actual executed forward/LN/QuickGELU source embedded in the radial condition record.
Pre_LN_structure.ours: A finite algebraic condition for the closed last-MLP class-equality objective; not a new defense, accuracy result, universal impossibility or prerequisite for all methods.

ZSKD.finding: 从训练后的分类器权重计算类别相似度，按Dirichlet软标签反演输入。与单纯one-hot自信输入不同；MNIST表为LeNet教师/学生和24000合成图，不是CLIP大幅参数修改的实验。
ZSKD.source_detail: generateDirch先将给定每行重新min-max，再乘调用scale=1并加1e-4；main把1和0.1两种矩阵拼接，但第二次min-max抵消了预缩放。不能直接把此固定发布脚本当成论文两种beta的忠实执行。
ZSKD.our_head_difference: 原AGA heads.py由公开CLIP文本编码与类别模板产生分类头。它不是MNIST真实训练得到的分类器，其余弦相似度不能直接当成MNIST视觉训练统计；这是由构造源码得到的适配判断。

CVLM.finding: 直接针对CLIP的无数据蒸馏，使用预训练VQGAN、文本风格与分类一致性，再训练学生。附录E明确生成器提供自然图先验；不能把其效果归为只优化CLIP像素或直接搬入当前仅目标/基座权重的构造权限。
CVLM.source_detail: text_customization.py固定CLIP和VQGAN，更新生成潜变量和风格嵌入；meta_distillation.py使用带预训练初始化的独立ResNet学生。forward_meta通过param.data临时更新再恢复，未保留普通可微内步的参数路径，不能仅凭create_graph=True就声称精确复现论文的二阶元梯度。
